endorsements.quote: The investment in a complete capacity-building program which is based on the knowledge of health, digital literacy, and ethics will give youth health volunteers the ability to become digital intermediaries.

unlisted_practices: Formally include youth health volunteers in national digital health strategies and acknowledge them as critical digital intermediaries.
Establish governance structures that explicitly support volunteer roles, with acknowledgment, oversight and accountability measures for volunteers using digital and AI tools.
Provide youth health volunteers with institutional support, including setting expectations, mentoring, and recognition of their digital labor.
Include youth voices and youth health volunteers as strategic partners in digital health governance.
Evaluate the impact of AI-driven tools and digital decision support systems on youth health volunteers.
Incorporate youth health volunteers into the production of digital health evidence as implementers and research participants.

screen.reason: Commentary/viewpoint discussing the role of youth health volunteers as intermediaries in digital health and AI-powered tools, suggesting governance, capacity building, and institutional support.
